Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Jitendra Chaudhary, learned Senior Advocate 
assisted by Mr. Suryakant Maithani, learned counsel for 
the petitioner.
2. None is present on behalf of the respondents, as 
the matter is being taken up on mention.
3. It is contended by learned Senior Advocate 
appearing for the petitioner that the writ petition has 
been filed before this Court seeking release of the 
property which was attached by the E.D. during the 
investigation under the PMLA, Act, 2002 (for short, “the 
Act, 2002”). He further contended that the remedy 
available to the petitioner is to move an application 
before the Special Judge, PMLA, for the release of the 
property on the ground that the trial has not been 
concluded under sub-section (7) of Section 8 of the Act, 
2002. He also contended that he wants to withdraw the 
writ petition if permission is granted to file such an 
application before the PMLA Court.
4. Since no one is present on behalf of the respondents 
before this Court, put up this matter on 16.11.2026.
5. Urgency application (IA No.5/2026) stands 
disposed of accordingly.
(Pankaj Purohit, J.)
04.11.2026 AK
